researcher_notes: Checked against the 529 existing US gas rows. No row matches by name or owner. Williston Basin (P0281) and Bison (P0158) are other operators' systems. The operator's own page says it has more than 2,100 miles of natural gas transmission pipeline serving Montana, South Dakota and Nebraska, with storage. Single source, the operator page, which loaded and states the length. The page does not give a diameter range in the current text, so diameter is left blank. The figure is a system total across three states and may include small lines, so the row is a system-level row and a person should decide whether it fits the tracker's pipe-size scope. Start and end locations are not stated. The company also has FERC-silent intrastate lines, so absence from FERC is not a concern. No route found. Owner name: the ownership gazetteer has NorthWestern Corp and NorthWestern Energy Group Inc as near matches, not adopted; a person should pick the right entity.
